com.vechain.thorclient.clients.base

Class SubscribeSocket<T>

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.vechain.thorclient.clients.base.SubscribeSocket<T>
  • Type Parameters:
    T - the deserialized subscription response type

    public class SubscribeSocket<T>
extends Object
    A live subscription to a Thor node.

    The underlying WebSocket implementation is held by composition rather than inheritance so that no third-party type appears in this class's public API. That is deliberate: the previous Jetty-based implementation exposed org.eclipse.jetty.websocket types through its constructor and callback, which meant Jetty could not be replaced without breaking callers.

    Callbacks are delivered on the WebSocket read thread, not the thread that created the subscription. Implementations of SubscribingCallback must therefore be thread-safe with respect to their own state.

    • Method Detail

      • isConnected

        public boolean isConnected()
        Whether the subscription is currently open. A subscription that failed to connect, was closed locally, or was dropped by the node reports false.

      • getLastError

        public Exception getLastError()
        The most recent transport-level error, or null if none occurred.

        A failed connect leaves the subscription closed without telling the caller why; this is where the reason ends up, typically a ConnectException for a refused port, an SSLException for a TLS mismatch, or an UnknownHostException for a bad host. Check it whenever isConnected() is false.

        Returns:
        the last error reported by the WebSocket, or null

      • close

        public void close(int status,
                  String message)
        Close the subscription, sending a close frame to the node.
        Parameters:
        status - RFC 6455 status code, e.g. NORMAL_CLOSURE
        message - human-readable close reason
